method: the state pointer at Controller+0x2A0 was read as a live vtable pointer, converted to an RVA with the live Game.dll base, and compared against the 24-state map resolved from RegisterStates
exactness: The RVA matches the disk-resolved LongIdle vtable exactly, not approximately; the neighbouring Idle 0x744e60 and MoveTo 0x744930 are distinct.
why_it_matters: Both live controllers sit in LongIdle, whose +0x70 is the shared empty stub. EndOfPathReached therefore returns without any state change or movement in this state, which is consistent with the whole OWN chain stopping rather than moving. A real click must first move the controller into MoveTo, whose +0x70 is the real body 0x1663F0.
not_claimed: that a click always selects MoveTo
why Count2F0 is 7 on player1 while its overlay is null
